risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantified, including revenue, income, acquisition, grant, and access-line figures. It acknowledges ongoing structural pressure from declining voice and switched-access revenues, competition, rate pressure, and credit-collection risk, while emphasizing broadband growth and acquisition-related offsets. Some forward-looking and promotional language, along with standard accounting-estimate caveats, limits precision regarding future performance.
